name: Parallel cache management with LRU
aliases: Sarton et al. LRU cache management
definition: A method by Sarton et al. [SCRL20] that generalizes page-table hierarchies for non-rendering purposes and processes cache misses on the GPU itself using CUDA shared memory to minimize memory transfers between CPU and GPU.
summary: Parallel cache management with LRU is a GPU-based method that minimizes CPU-GPU transfers by processing cache misses on the GPU using CUDA shared memory and decoupling residency management from spatial subdivision.
